conversion.original_title: groupKey与单告警fingerprint用途有什么不同？

body:
## 操作任务
实现summarize(payload)：读取真实Webhook的groupKey/groupLabels/alerts[].fingerprint，返回group_key、group_labels深拷贝、按字典序排序的alert_ids和alert_count。groupKey及每个fingerprint均须非空字符串，alerts非空且fingerprint不得重复，否则ValueError；不改输入。真实Alertmanager按service分组，api组有两台主机告警、db组有一条；须将三个独立fingerprint与真实GET /api/v2/alerts对应，不能把groupKey当成单告警身份，也不能拿第一条fingerprint冒充整组标识。输入告警顺序变化不改变总结。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
官方Alertmanager0.28.1真实API、调度分组及本地Webhook，不是手写的组身份样例。只验证组与单告警身份区别，不代表receiver更名不重发、跨集群去重或工单幂等已通过。自有临时进程和回环通道，不发外部消息，不改默认身份或构建镜像。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,datetime,json,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,sys,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/"checks"))
import task
from notifications_fixture import native,receiver,request,wait_for
binary=shutil.which("alertmanager") or shutil.which("alertmanager.exe")
assert binary and "0.28.1" in subprocess.check_output([binary,"--version"],stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=5)
print("NATIVE_PLATFORM_READY",flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-group-identity-") as temp,receiver() as (url,seen):
 config={"route":{"receiver":"private","group_by":["service"],"group_wait":"250ms","group_interval":"1s","repeat_interval":"1h"},"receivers":[{"name":"private","webhook_configs":[{"url":url}]}]}
 with native(pathlib.Path(temp)/"native",config) as (base,path,proc):
  now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc);alerts=[dict(labels=dict(alertname="PrivateGrouping",service=service,instance=instance),startsAt=now.isoformat(),endsAt=(now+datetime.timedelta(minutes=5)).isoformat()) for service,instance in [("api","host-a"),("api","host-b"),("db","host-a")]]
  assert request("POST",base+"/api/v2/alerts",alerts)[0]==200
  wait_for(lambda:{p["groupLabels"].get("service") for p in seen}=={"api","db"})
  groups={p["groupLabels"]["service"]:p for p in seen};assert len(groups["api"]["alerts"])==2 and len(groups["db"]["alerts"])==1
  api=request("GET",base+"/api/v2/alerts")[1];actual={r["fingerprint"] for r in api};assert len(actual)==3
  unchanged=copy.deepcopy(groups)
  print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: distinguish actual native notification groups from three individual alert identities",flush=True)
  a,b=task.summarize(groups["api"]),task.summarize(groups["db"])
  for key,summary in [("api",a),("db",b)]:
   expected=groups[key]
   assert summary==dict(group_key=expected["groupKey"],group_labels=expected["groupLabels"],alert_ids=sorted(r["fingerprint"] for r in expected["alerts"]),alert_count=len(expected["alerts"]))
  assert a["group_key"]!=b["group_key"] and set(a["alert_ids"])|set(b["alert_ids"])==actual
  assert groups==unchanged and a["alert_count"]==2 and b["alert_count"]==1
  print("NATIVE_ALERTMANAGER_TWO_REAL_GROUPKEYS_THREE_API_FINGERPRINTS_TWO_ALERTS_SHARE_GROUP_NOT_ALERT_ID",flush=True)
  reversed_payload=copy.deepcopy(groups["api"]);reversed_payload["alerts"].reverse();assert task.summarize(reversed_payload)==a
  duplicate=copy.deepcopy(groups["api"]);duplicate["alerts"].append(copy.deepcopy(duplicate["alerts"][0]))
  try:task.summarize(duplicate)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError("duplicate individual identities not rejected")
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
